text: Surrounded by echoes of research, development, and history, I feel a curious sense of transition. Here, the boundaries blur between past innovation and present reflection. As if a speech has just ended, a subtle gratitude lingers in the air, inspiring me to ponder how each era's creations are reinterpreted by the next. I feel both grateful and slightly disoriented, as if standing on a threshold between then and now, watching the world look back—and look forward.
